page: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-32-lssd is an x86_64 instance configured with 32 dedicated vCPUs across 16 physical cores, running on an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor clocked at 2.3 GHz. The architecture incorporates 504 MB of L3 cache, along with specialized instruction set extensions including AVX-512, AMX-Tile, AMX-INT8, and cryptographic accelerators like VAES and SHA-NI. The instance allocates 248 GB of system memory, providing an elevated memory allocation of 7.75 GB per vCPU, and integrates 2010 GB of local NVMe SSD storage across 5 drives without dedicated GPU accelerators.

Benchmark results demonstrate strong single-thread and memory-intensive execution capabilities. Single-core performance ranks in the top tier on Geekbench (2307.0) and delivers high throughput in single-threaded gzip compression (36.83 GB/sec) and bzip3 decompression (15.57 GB/sec). Multi-threaded compute capacity is robust, shown by a PassMark CPU score of 53228.41 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 18257.0. In-memory data throughput is highlighted by 62.26 million operations per second in Redis SET workloads and 59.7 GB/sec in static web serving benchmarks. Small-model LLM generation also achieves top-tier results at 362.23 tokens per second, though throughput scales down to average tiers when running 70B parameter models.

From an infrastructure efficiency perspective, the machine provides high memory and local storage density per compute thread without requiring distributed block storage overhead. The integration of 2010 GB of high-speed local NVMe storage reduces network storage dependency, while the dedicated core allocation ensures consistent latency. Workloads best aligned with this configuration include in-memory databases, caching tiers, data transformation pipelines, and localized analytics that require rapid disk caching alongside sizable memory footprints.
description: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-32-lssd is a memory-dense compute instance powered by an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor running at 2.3 GHz. The configuration supplies 32 dedicated vCPUs across 16 physical cores, 248 GB of RAM (7.75 GB per vCPU), 504 MB of L3 cache, and 2010 GB of local NVMe SSD storage partitioned across 5 drives. Hardware extensions include AVX-512 and AMX matrix instructions. The instance delivers high single-thread performance, ranking in the top decile for Geekbench single-core and compression workloads, alongside strong multi-core ratings on PassMark. With 62.26 million operations per second in Redis benchmarks and rapid local I/O, the instance offers balanced high-throughput processing. It is technically suited for memory-bound applications, Redis clusters, analytics caching, and transactional database workloads requiring fast local disk access.
